description: This Java source file defines the EnforcerDeviceAdminReceiver class, which extends DeviceAdminReceiver to handle device administration events related to managed profiles, specifically the completion of profile provisioning.

classes.name: EnforcerDeviceAdminReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class that handles events related to device admin, specifically profile provisioning, and provides utility to generate its own ComponentName.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
methods.description: Handles the event when a managed profile provisioning is complete, launching an activity to enable the profile.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns a ComponentName for this receiver class to be used throughout the app.
